title: Quick Roasted Ukrainian Myeongnan Roe Skewers
description: A dense and adventurous Ukrainian dish featuring myeongnan-roe, this recipe is egg-free-friendly and perfect for a snack, roasted to perfection in a copper mug. It combines the flavors of the sea with traditional Ukrainian spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the myeongnan-roe onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the myeongnan-roe, making sure each piece is fully coated.
Place the skewers in a copper mug and roast in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the myeongnan-roe.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
